item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meena's mother cooks spinach for dinner. After cooking, the spinach loses its bright green colour and becomes soft. Meena reads that some nutrients, such as vitamin C, can be reduced by heat during cooking.

Which statement correctly explains what happens when vegetables are cooked?

options.A: Cooking destroys all the nutrients in vegetables, so cooked vegetables have no food value.
options.B: Cooking does not change vegetables at all; they keep every nutrient unchanged.
options.C: Cooking can change the colour and texture of vegetables and may reduce some nutrients like vitamin C, but other nutrients remain.
options.D: The loss of bright colour during cooking proves that all the vitamin C has been destroyed.
